title: Simulator configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $y$ be a finite Boolean input. A configuration of the simulator machine is specified by a state of its simulator state set or no state, an input-head position among the $|y|+2$ available positions, the contents and head positions of each of the $M.k$ simulated work tapes and three auxiliary tapes, and a finite Boolean output string; the simulated tapes precede the auxiliary tapes in the simulator's work-tape tuple.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols
The simulator state is present or absent
The input-head position belongs to the $|y|+2$ positions
Each simulated work tape has integer-indexed contents and an integer head position
Each of the three auxiliary tapes has integer-indexed contents and an integer head position
The output is a finite Boolean string
